subject: Obtaining margins of derivatives of outcome

messages.author: a259015b36a46546
messages.subject: Obtaining margins of derivatives of outcome
parts:
Dear All, 

I want to obtain the marginal effects after fitting an interaction model with r-inla. Considering the regression equation below (purely demonstrative)

y=β_0+β_1×bp+β_2×" age + " β_3×" bp "×"age"+ϵ

I want to obtain the derivate of y, given as 

dy/d(bp)=β_1+β_3×age

However, for the marginal effects, I want to fix age at different values e.g. age=(15 30 45). 

Using the sample data below, I tried 


df= data.frame(y=runif(n=250, min=0.5, max=25), age=runif(n=250, min=15, max=45),
               bp=runif(n=250, min=60, max=200))


r = inla(y ~ 1 + bp*age,
         data = df,
         control.predictor = list(compute=TRUE))

summary(r)


The challenge is the next steps for obtaining the marginal effects or margins of derivatives of responses.

Any help would be greatly appreciated. Thank you.
